text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки, Бико Пегасус, and Hishi
Akebono
finish the Mile Championship
in a blaze of glory.
They grin at each
other in satisfied exhaustion
after
running their hearts out in a fierce
struggle
for first.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Their positive emotions touch the hearts
of the
audience too. Even the younger
racer who has
been watching Фудзи Кисэки
is moved to tears.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, she asks to participate in
the
Takamatsunomiya Kinen, a
1,200-meter G1 turf
sprint.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I'm puzzled by her straightforward
suggestion
considering how much of a
trickster she usually is,
but she must
have a reason.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
